scenes.topic_description:
Situation: The learner has arrived for a first job interview in France and is meeting the recruiter at the start of the conversation. This opening sets the tone and covers identification and basic work background before more detailed evaluation begins. The learner is nervous about questions on experience.
Learner: Candidate. Partner: Recruiter.
Not in this scene: discussing strengths and weaknesses, answering difficult fit questions, salary, schedule, contract details.

scenes.topic_description:
Situation: The interview moves to the decisive part, where the recruiter tests motivation and past experience. This is the core interaction because the learner's main worry is handling questions about experience well enough to show fit for the role and leave a strong impression.
Learner: Candidate. Partner: Recruiter.
Not in this scene: introductions, stating your name, saying which job you applied for, basic work history, salary negotiation, signing documents.
